snippet.title: Atomic Heart Blood on Crystal DLC - Launch Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Blood on Crystal, the final DLC#4, concludes the story of #AtomicHeart’s first part on April 16!

P-3 and the Twin venture into the Crystal Complex to face CHAR-les in an all-out bloody showdown against new enemies - Polymorphs - and the most insane bosses of Facility 3826

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
